title: CWTM: Leveraging Contextualized Word Embeddings from BERT for Neural Topic Modeling
subcategory: BoW-free neural topic model on contextual word embeddings
task: Topic modelling directly from BERT contextual word embeddings
problem: Bag-of-words topic models ignore word order and cannot handle out-of-vocabulary words in new documents.
architecture: Each BERT contextualised word embedding is mapped to a word-topic vector; an importance network weights words; document-topic vectors are weighted averages of word-topic vectors; trained with mutual-information, masked-language-model and reconstruction losses plus MMD distribution matching at document and topic levels; no BoW input.
metrics: OOV robustness (accuracy gap between test sets)
key_results: 50 topics: coherence 0.600 (20NG), 0.626 (TagMyNews), 0.633 (AGNews) vs LDA 0.550, 0.586, 0.578; on DBpedia LDA is slightly higher (0.571 vs 0.569).
OOV test (AGNews): accuracy 0.871 vs 0.85 on low-overlap documents (difference 0.021) vs LDA 0.826 vs 0.732.
strengths: Removes the BoW dependence and gives word-level topic vectors usable for downstream tasks (e.g. NER).

limitations.text: Compared against only four baselines, none of them recent embedding-clustering or LLM methods.

notes: Authors state code will be shared on acceptance.
